title: CPI upside surprise and BTC 1-minute liquidity shock: conditional execution-quality challenger
hypothesis: For existing Superman Paper candidates, a timestamp-safe macro-release shock and liquidity-cost interaction may improve net risk-adjusted execution and tail drawdown compared with static cost assumptions while preserving trade frequency; no directional alpha is established.
mechanism: BLS September CPI printed 3.7% YoY versus 3.6% reported pre-release consensus, with core 2.6% versus 2.5%. Higher-than-expected inflation can shift expected policy rates and risk appetite. The BTC-USDT-SWAP 12:30 UTC 1-minute candle fell 1.1406% (83842.5 open to 82886.2 close), with 424715.88 contracts versus 23018.54 in the preceding minute (18.45x). This is one observed event and does not establish repeatable strategy edge.

exact_rule_or_model_spec.name: MACRO_CPI_SURPRISE_LIQUIDITY_GUARD_V1
exact_rule_or_model_spec.status: TEST_OFFLINE_ONLY; NEEDS_IMPLEMENTATION if historical event consensus or L2 snapshots unavailable
exact_rule_or_model_spec.asof: For each completed 1m decision bar t, use only actual macro releases publicly disseminated by t and consensus values archived before t0=release; ingestion timestamps must also be <=t. Never use future candles, revised data, or later Polymarket prices.
exact_rule_or_model_spec.features: surprise_pp=actual_headline_yoy-pre_release_consensus_yoy; core_surprise_pp similarly. Event window [t0,t0+60m]. shock_flag=abs(surprise_pp)>=0.1 AND abs(last_completed_1m_return)>=0.008 AND 1m volume >=5x median of previous 60 completed 1m bars. Treat missing consensus or volume history as unavailable.
exact_rule_or_model_spec.challenger: Only on existing baseline Paper candidates in event window, compare unchanged baseline to execution-cost-aware same-side candidate ranking. Activate risk flag when estimated round-trip fee+funding+depth-walk slippage >2x 30-day matched UTC-minute baseline. Replace candidate only when incremental expected net edge exceeds complete switching cost+2bps; no new trades, direction, size or leverage changes. Missing data retains baseline.

required_data: Immutable official release timestamps and first-publication actual values
Timestamped pre-release consensus from archived public sources
Point-in-time BTC/ETH and major-perp 1m bars, volume, mark and OI
Order-book L2 spread/depth and realistic market impact
Paper candidate decisions and realized fills/outcomes
transaction_cost_implications: Include maker/taker fees, funding actually crossed, bid-ask spread, depth-walk impact, missed-fill opportunity cost, turnover, 25% exit-depth haircut and 1.5x/2x slippage stress. Shock may increase slippage even if spread snapshot appears narrow.
expected_benefit: Potential reduction of expensive event-window fills and tail drawdown without forcing direction; unproven until locked OOS and future-only shadow.
risks: Single CPI observation is not a repeatable edge
Reuters consensus requires auditable pre-event archival timestamp
Market may reverse quickly after first-minute selloff
Sparse L2 and delayed macro ingestion can bias results
Event filter may miss profitable moves or reduce coverage
Macro surprise may be confounded by other contemporaneous events
falsification_criteria: No net PnL/profit-factor/max-drawdown improvement over baseline in locked OOS and prospective shadow
Trade retention <95% or capital utilization >5% below baseline
Matched non-event/placebo controls perform as well
Any as-of leakage or event timestamp misalignment
Effect concentrated in fewer than 10 independent macro events
validation_plan: First audit October 14 as-of event timing, consensus archive and 1m/L2 observations. Run chronological purged train/validation/locked test on >=20 independent CPI/PPI/FOMC release clusters with multiple regimes; include ablations and placebo controls. Freeze thresholds before >=90 new future-only Paper days and >=6 new independent macro releases (extend shadow until both met). Compare net PnL, PF, max drawdown, tail loss, coverage, retention, trade frequency, capital utilization and 1x/1.5x/2x execution-cost sensitivity. Superman/Guardian gates remain mandatory.
minimum_sample: 20 independent historical macro-release clusters, 3000 baseline decisions, >=200 event-window candidate decisions, >=90 future-only days AND >=6 independent prospective releases

primary_drivers: BTC post-CPI first-minute selloff; no synchronized flow/OI change
BTC -1.14% release minute; macro upside surprise
Macro repricing but no corroborated positioning trend
Uncertain persistence; event effects may reverse
ETH rolling decline, event-aligned candles unavailable
Cross-asset risk-off plausible, not confirmed by ETH event flow
BTC selloff and weaker ETH ticker; breadth unavailable
Macro surprise risk-off mechanism, incomplete cross-section

probability_calibration_note: These are cautious heuristic scenario weights, NOT empirically calibrated probabilities or trade instructions.
contradictions: Strong initial BTC negative price/volume reaction but no synchronized OI delta, liquidation intensity or taker imbalance
ETH event-aligned price path and broad breadth not verified
No relevant verified Polymarket probability velocity or executable book
invalidation_triggers: BTC regains and holds pre-release 83842.5 with corroborated taker buying and OI improvement
Synchronized derivatives and cross-sectional flow negate risk-off mechanism
Cost-aware candidate replacement fails prospective benchmarks
